artifact.header:
import Mathlib
open scoped TensorProduct
noncomputable section
universe uK uV
namespace LatticeIR
def R (p : ℕ) : Subring ℚ :=
  Subring.closure {q : ℚ | ∃ a b : ℤ, ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ b ∧ q = (a : ℚ) / (b : ℚ)}
instance ratModule (V : Type*) [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] : Module ℚ V :=
  Module.compHom V (algebraMap ℚ ℂ)
instance complexAlgebra (p : ℕ) : Algebra (R p) ℂ :=
  ((algebraMap ℚ ℂ).comp (R p).subtype).toAlgebra
instance localModule (p : ℕ) (V : Type*) [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] : Module (R p) V :=
  Module.compHom V (algebraMap (R p) ℂ)
variable {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
def dp (f : Module.End ℂ V) (r : ℕ) : Module.End ℂ V :=
  ((r.factorial : ℂ)⁻¹) • f ^ r
def e (y : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (i : ℕ) : V := dp y i v
abbrev MR (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) := (R p) ⊗[ℤ] M
def mu (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) : MR p M →ₗ[R p] V :=
  M.subtype.liftBaseChange (R p)
abbrev VK (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V) := K ⊗[ℤ] M
def image (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) : Submodule (R p) V :=
  LinearMap.range (mu p M)
def Ji (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (y : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (i : ℕ) : Submodule (R p) ℂ :=
  letI : IsScalarTower (R p) ℂ V := IsScalarTower.of_compHom (R p) ℂ V
  letI : IsScalarTower (R p) ℂ ℂ := IsScalarTower.of_compHom (R p) ℂ ℂ
  (image p M).comap ((LinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℂ V (e y v i)).restrictScalars (R p))
def unit {F W : Type*} [Field F] [AddCommGroup W] [Module F W]
    {n : ℕ} (B : Module.Basis (Fin n) F W) (i j : Fin n) : Module.End F W :=
  (LinearMap.toSpanSingleton F W (B i)).comp (B.coord j)
def basisAt {F W : Type*} [Field F] [AddCommGroup W] [Module F W]
    {n : ℕ} (B : Module.Basis (Fin n) F W) (i : ℕ) : W :=
  if hi : i < n then B ⟨i, hi⟩ else 0
def Stable (M : Submodule ℤ V) (f : Module.End ℂ V) : Prop :=
  ∀ w ∈ M, f w ∈ M
def latticeOp (M : Submodule ℤ V) (f : Module.End ℂ V) : Module.End ℤ M :=
  letI := Classical.propDecidable
  if hf : Stable M f then (f.restrictScalars ℤ).restrict hf else 0
def kop (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V) (f : Module.End ℂ V) : Module.End K (VK K M) :=
  (latticeOp M f).baseChange K
def kdp {K W : Type*} [Field K] [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    (f : Module.End K W) (r : ℕ) : Module.End K W :=
  ((r.factorial : K)⁻¹) • f ^ r
def Coordinates (lam : ℤ) (y : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  ∃ B : Module.Basis (Fin (lam.toNat + 1)) ℂ V, ∀ i, B i = e y v i.val
def rop (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (f : Module.End ℂ V) : Module.End (R p) (MR p M) :=
  (latticeOp M f).baseChange (R p)
def pSub (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) : Submodule (R p) (MR p M) :=
  Submodule.span (R p) (Set.range (fun z : MR p M => (p : R p) • z))
abbrev QuotMR (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) := MR p M ⧸ pSub p M
def Inv {F W : Type*} [Field F] [AddCommGroup W] [Module F W]
    (W' : Submodule F W) (f : Module.End F W) : Prop :=
  ∀ w ∈ W', f w ∈ W'
def Actions {F W : Type*} [Field F] [AddCommGroup W] [Module F W]
    (lam : ℤ) (a b c : Module.End F W) (B : Module.Basis (Fin (lam.toNat + 1)) F W) : Prop :=
  (∀ i, a (B i) = if i.val = 0 then 0 else
    ((lam - (i.val : ℤ) + 1 : ℤ) : F) • basisAt B (i.val - 1)) ∧
  (∀ i, b (B i) = if i.val < lam.toNat then
    ((i.val + 1 : ℕ) : F) • basisAt B (i.val + 1) else 0) ∧
  (∀ i, c (B i) = ((lam - 2 * (i.val : ℤ) : ℤ) : F) • B i)
def Strings (lam : ℤ) (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  (∀ d : ℕ, h ((y ^ d) v) = ((lam - 2 * (d : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℂ) • (y ^ d) v) ∧
  (∀ d : ℕ, 1 ≤ d → x ((y ^ d) v) =
    (((d : ℤ) * (lam - (d : ℤ) + 1) : ℤ) : ℂ) • (y ^ (d - 1)) v)
def ComplexOutput (lam : ℤ) (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  0 < lam + 1 ∧ Fintype.card (Fin (lam.toNat + 1)) = lam.toNat + 1 ∧
  Coordinates lam y v ∧ Strings lam x y h v ∧
  (∀ d : ℕ, lam < (d : ℤ) → (y ^ d) v = 0) ∧
  (∀ B : Module.Basis (Fin (lam.toNat + 1)) ℂ V,
    (∀ i, B i = e y v i.val) → Actions lam x y h B) ∧
  (∀ (r : ℕ) (i : Fin (lam.toNat + 1)),
    dp x r (e y v i.val) =
      if r ≤ i.val then ((Nat.choose (lam.toNat - i.val + r) r : ℕ) : ℂ) • e y v (i.val - r) else 0) ∧
  (∀ (r : ℕ) (i : Fin (lam.toNat + 1)),
    dp y r (e y v i.val) =
      if i.val + r ≤ lam.toNat then ((Nat.choose (i.val + r) r : ℕ) : ℂ) • e y v (i.val + r) else 0)
def LocalBasics (p : ℕ) (lam : ℤ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (x y : Module.End ℂ V) : Prop :=
  Function.Injective (mu p M) ∧
  Nonempty (Module.Basis (Fin (lam.toNat + 1)) (R p) (MR p M)) ∧
  Submodule.span ℂ (image p M : Set V) = ⊤ ∧
  (∀ r : ℕ, (∀ z, mu p M (rop p M (dp x r) z) = dp x r (mu p M z)) ∧
    (∀ z, mu p M (rop p M (dp y r) z) = dp y r (mu p M z))) ∧
  (∀ (r : ℕ) (w : V), w ∈ image p M → dp x r w ∈ image p M ∧ dp y r w ∈ image p M)
def MatrixOutput (p : ℕ) (lam : ℤ) (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (x y : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  LocalBasics p lam M x y ∧
  (∀ j : Fin (lam.toNat + 1), IsUnit (Nat.choose lam.toNat j.val : R p)) ∧
  (∀ B : Module.Basis (Fin (lam.toNat + 1)) ℂ V,
    (∀ i, B i = e y v i.val) → ∀ i j,
    unit B i j =
      ((Nat.choose lam.toNat j.val : ℂ)⁻¹) •
      (dp x (lam.toNat - i.val) * dp y lam.toNat * dp x lam.toNat * dp y (lam.toNat - j.val)) ∧
    ∀ w ∈ image p M, unit B i j w ∈ image p M)
def CommonOutput (p : ℕ) (lam : ℤ) (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (x y : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  0 < lam + 1 ∧ Coordinates lam y v ∧ LocalBasics p lam M x y ∧
  (∀ i : Fin (lam.toNat + 1), Ji p M y v i.val = Ji p M y v 0) ∧
  (Ji p M y v 0).FG ∧ Ji p M y v 0 ≠ ⊥ ∧
  (∃ F : ((Fin (lam.toNat + 1)) → Ji p M y v 0) ≃ₗ[R p] MR p M,
    ∀ c, mu p M (F c) = ∑ i, ((c i : Ji p M y v 0) : ℂ) • e y v i.val)
def PrincipalOutput (p : ℕ) (lam : ℤ) (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (y : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  ∃ b : ℂ, b ∈ Ji p M y v 0 ∧ b ≠ 0 ∧
    Ji p M y v 0 = Submodule.span (R p) {b} ∧
    ∃ B : Module.Basis (Fin (lam.toNat + 1)) (R p) (MR p M),
      ∀ i, mu p M (B i) = b • e y v i.val
def ReducedOutput (K : Type*) [Field K] (lam : ℤ) (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) : Prop :=
  0 < lam + 1 ∧ Stable M x ∧ Stable M y ∧ Stable M h ∧
  kop K M h = kop K M x * kop K M y - kop K M y * kop K M x ∧
  kop K M h * kop K M x - kop K M x * kop K M h = (2 : K) • kop K M x ∧
  kop K M h * kop K M y - kop K M y * kop K M h = (-2 : K) • kop K M y ∧
  ∃ B : Module.Basis (Fin (lam.toNat + 1)) K (VK K M),
    Actions lam (kop K M x) (kop K M y) (kop K M h) B ∧
    (∀ r : ℕ, r ≤ lam.toNat → (r.factorial : K) ≠ 0 ∧
      (latticeOp M (dp x r)).baseChange K = kdp (kop K M x) r ∧
      (latticeOp M (dp y r)).baseChange K = kdp (kop K M y) r) ∧
    (∀ i j : Fin (lam.toNat + 1), (Nat.choose lam.toNat j.val : K) ≠ 0 ∧
      unit B i j = ((Nat.choose lam.toNat j.val : K)⁻¹) •
        (kdp (kop K M x) (lam.toNat - i.val) * kdp (kop K M y) lam.toNat *
         kdp (kop K M x) lam.toNat * kdp (kop K M y) (lam.toNat - j.val)))
def Target (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V) (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) : Prop :=
  Nontrivial (VK K M) ∧ ∀ W : Submodule K (VK K M),
    Inv W (kop K M x) → Inv W (kop K M y) → Inv W (kop K M h) → W = ⊥ ∨ W = ⊤
end LatticeIR
open LatticeIR

premise_types.H001: p.Prime ∧ CharP K p ∧ 0 ≤ lam ∧ lam < (p : ℤ)
premise_types.H002:
FiniteDimensional ℂ V ∧ Module.finrank ℂ V = lam.toNat + 1 ∧ Nontrivial V ∧
  (∀ W : Submodule ℂ V, Inv W x → Inv W y → Inv W h → W = ⊥ ∨ W = ⊤) ∧
  (∃ w : V, w ≠ 0 ∧ x w = 0 ∧ h w = (lam : ℂ) • w)
premise_types.H003: h * x - x * h = (2 : ℂ) • x ∧ h * y - y * h = (-2 : ℂ) • y ∧ x * y - y * x = h
premise_types.H004: v ≠ 0 ∧ x v = 0 ∧ h v = (lam : ℂ) • v
premise_types.H005:
(∃ d : ℕ, ∃ bZ : Module.Basis (Fin d) ℤ M,
    ∃ bC : Module.Basis (Fin d) ℂ V, ∀ i, bC i = (bZ i : V)) ∧
  ∀ r : ℕ, Stable M (dp x r) ∧ Stable M (dp y r)

artifact.conclusion_type: Target K M x y h
artifact.representation: Use one complex vector space V and its three Chevalley endomorphisms. H003 is the action of the standard sl2 presentation, H002 retains finite dimension, irreducibility and existence of a highest-weight vector, and H004 supplies the chosen vector. The omitted explicit LieModule bundle is determined uniquely by these three generator actions and their brackets; no result uses a different complex representation. M is a ℤ-submodule, equivalently an additive subgroup. Admissibility is a finite integer basis whose ambient images form a complex basis plus stability under every divided power, equivalent to U_Z stability. p:ℕ represents the positive prime integer and lam:ℤ is unchanged. H001 contains primality, characteristic and 0≤lam<p. Every use of toNat is guarded by that nonnegative hypothesis; Fin(lam.toNat+1) corresponds bijectively to the integer interval I. All exponents r,d use ℕ, equivalent to nonnegative integers. R is implemented as the subring closure of fractions with denominator prime to p; T005 proves this closure has exactly that carrier before relying on its localization meaning. MR=R⊗ℤM; mu is the multiplication lift, and image is used only with proved injectivity. Ji is the inverse image of mu(MR) under c↦c e_i, not an assumed rank-one submodule. VK is K⊗ℤM consistently throughout, using the canonical tensor flip from the source M⊗ℤK; no additional vector-space model is introduced. latticeOp is the restriction when its Stable guard holds and zero otherwise; H005 and the bracket identity prove the guards before it is used as an induced action, explicitly exported in N005. kop is its scalar extension. Module.End multiplication is composition with the right factor first, powers are iterated operators, and kdp is the inverse factorial scalar multiple. Basis coordinate maps define unit B i j: w↦(j-th coordinate of w) B_i. Actions uses integer casts into the coefficient field; basisAt extends a finite basis by zero and uses predecessor/successor only under the source boundary guards. Output predicates abbreviate full displayed propositions and assume none of their clauses. Background notes remain local references; M001 is applied directly from the pinned library at T009 and is not a premise port.

steps.statement: Strings lam x y h v
steps.explanation: Prove the two commutator recurrences by natural induction; d≥1 is a guard on the x formula. Nonnegative integer exponents use ℕ with its canonical identification with the source range.

Show e_i≠0 by the iterated raising formula. Isolate coefficients with the product of h minus the other complex eigenvalues, then use finite dimension. Fin(lam.toNat+1) enumerates exactly the integer interval I under H001.

steps.statement: ∀ d : ℕ, lam < (d : ℤ) → (y ^ d) v = 0
steps.explanation: Use the e-basis spectrum to kill y^(lam+1)v at the absent complex weight, then all higher powers. No reduction of weights.

steps.statement: ComplexOutput lam x y h v
steps.explanation: N001: derive the x,y,h coordinate formulas, iterate and divide by factorials to obtain both integral binomial formulas including out-of-range zero cases; package all earlier clauses.

steps.statement:
(∀ q : ℚ, q ∈ R p ↔ ∃ a b : ℤ, ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ b ∧ q = (a : ℚ) / (b : ℚ)) ∧
  LocalBasics p lam M x y
steps.explanation: Prove the closure-based R equals the source rational local ring; this is a representation obligation, not an assumption. Extend an admissible integer basis to R, prove μ injective by its complex independence, and prove spanning and divided-power preservation/intertwining on pure tensors. Basis.baseChange and LinearMap.liftBaseChange implement these maps.

steps.statement: MatrixOutput p lam M x y v
steps.explanation: N002: compute Q and the three matrix-unit factors on the e-basis. Prove the binomial integers are units in R using factorial divisibility below p, then show their compositions preserve μ(M_R). Multiplication of endomorphisms applies the right factor first, as in Module.End.mul_apply.

steps.statement: CommonOutput p lam M x y v
steps.explanation: N003: coordinate projections give finitely generated J_i; matrix units identify them all and spanning proves nonzero. The displayed equivalence J^I≃M_R must have the exact coordinate-sum formula after μ. Prove bijectivity using the complex e-basis and μ injectivity; do not assume J has rational rank one.

steps.statement:
let J := Ji p M y v 0
  (∃ theta : (ℚ ⊗[R p] J) →ₗ[ℚ] ℂ,
    (∀ (q : ℚ) (c : J), theta (TensorProduct.tmul (R p) q c) = (q : ℂ) * (c : ℂ)) ∧
    Function.Injective theta) ∧ FiniteDimensional ℚ (ℚ ⊗[R p] J)
steps.explanation: Use the rational fraction field of R. Construct multiplication theta and prove injectivity by a common nonzero denominator. Tensor a finite R-generating family to prove finite dimensionality. Establish any needed scalar-tower compatibility locally from the explicitly defined embeddings; it is not a new premise.

steps.statement:
let J := Ji p M y v 0
  Module.finrank ℚ (ℚ ⊗[R p] J) = 1 ∧
  ∀ a : ℂ, a ∈ J → a ≠ 0 → ∀ c : ℂ, c ∈ J → ∃! q : ℚ, c = (q : ℂ) * a
steps.explanation: Tensor the coordinate equivalence and a finite R-basis to get n=nr with n>0. Use Module.finrank_pi_fintype directly at ℚ, finite I, constant family T; finite dimensionality supplies freeness and finite generation, and ℚ supplies StrongRankCondition. Through injective theta obtain the unique rational ratio.

steps.statement: PrincipalOutput p lam M y v
steps.explanation: N004: choose a nonzero a and finite nonempty generating family of nonzero members of J. Express each rational ratio as p^d times a unit of R by integer p-factor extraction. Choose the minimum exponent, prove J=Rb and construct the R-basis mapping to b e_i. Private choices remain local; the export is existence of b and the prescribed basis.

steps.statement:
∀ hc : CharP K p,
  letI : CharP K p := hc
  ∃ rho : R p →+* K,
    RingHom.ker rho = Ideal.span {(p : R p)} ∧
    (∀ (r : R p) (a b : ℤ), ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ b →
      (r : ℚ) = (a : ℚ) / (b : ℚ) → rho r = (a : K) / (b : K)) ∧
    letI : Algebra (R p) K := rho.toAlgebra
    ∃ phi : VK K M ≃ₗ[K] (K ⊗[R p] MR p M),
      (∀ (c : K) (m : M), phi (TensorProduct.tmul ℤ c m) =
        TensorProduct.tmul (R p) c (TensorProduct.tmul ℤ (1 : R p) m)) ∧
      (∀ f : Module.End ℂ V, Stable M f → ∀ z,
        phi (kop K M f z) = ((latticeOp M f).baseChange (R p)).baseChange K (phi z)) ∧
      ∃ qmod : Module (ZMod p) (QuotMR p M),
        letI : Module (ZMod p) (QuotMR p M) := qmod
        ∃ eta : (K ⊗[R p] MR p M) ≃ₗ[K] (K ⊗[ZMod p] QuotMR p M),
          ∀ (c : K) (z : MR p M), eta (TensorProduct.tmul (R p) c z) =
            TensorProduct.tmul (ZMod p) c (Submodule.Quotient.mk z)
steps.explanation: Construct the characteristic-p fraction map rho and kernel pR, then the two natural scalar-extension equivalences with the displayed pure-tensor formulas. Tensor factors consistently put the scalar ring first. Check balancing, inverses and naturality on pure tensors. The ZMod p action on M_R/pM_R is constructed here. H001 provides CharP only as a proposition; install it locally, without assuming extra instances globally.

steps.statement:
∃ B : Module.Basis (Fin (lam.toNat + 1)) K (VK K M),
  Actions lam (kop K M x) (kop K M y) (kop K M h) B
steps.explanation: Extend the R-basis b e_i along rho and transport it by phi inverse. Use Basis.baseChange, whose elements are 1⊗b_i, to prove independence as well as spanning. The integer coordinate matrices commute with the two scalar extensions. Any naturality for μ and the finite R-basis is proved here on pure tensors; μ identifies the image only after N002 injectivity.

steps.statement: ReducedOutput K lam M x y h
steps.explanation: N005: prove factorials through λ are nonzero in K, identify induced divided powers with inverse-factorial powers, and transport N002's matrix units to the basis constructed in S015 (reuse that same witness, not an arbitrary new basis). Reuse the construction of T012 from the R-basis when carrying the matrix identity: its mere Actions clause does not determine the witness's provenance, so the proof can choose its own transported witness using T010 and T011. Prove induced brackets from H003 and lattice stability and assemble every output clause.

steps.statement:
Nontrivial (VK K M) ∧
  ∀ (B : Module.Basis (Fin (lam.toNat + 1)) K (VK K M)),
    (∀ i j : Fin (lam.toNat + 1), (Nat.choose lam.toNat j.val : K) ≠ 0 ∧
      unit B i j = ((Nat.choose lam.toNat j.val : K)⁻¹) •
        (kdp (kop K M x) (lam.toNat - i.val) * kdp (kop K M y) lam.toNat *
         kdp (kop K M x) lam.toNat * kdp (kop K M y) (lam.toNat - j.val))) →
    ∀ W : Submodule K (VK K M), Inv W (kop K M x) → Inv W (kop K M y) →
      Inv W (kop K M h) → ∀ i j, Inv W (unit B i j)
steps.explanation: N005 gives a nonempty finite basis and hence nontriviality. Invariance under x_K and y_K gives invariance under powers, scalar multiples and compositions, so under every displayed matrix unit. Keep W arbitrary and its invariance hypotheses scoped in the implication.

steps.statement:
∀ (B : Module.Basis (Fin (lam.toNat + 1)) K (VK K M))
  (W : Submodule K (VK K M)), W ≠ ⊥ →
  ∃ w : VK K M, w ∈ W ∧ w ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ j : Fin (lam.toNat + 1), B.repr w j ≠ 0
steps.explanation: For a nonzero subspace choose a nonzero vector. Its finite basis coordinates cannot all vanish. The witness is local to this existence result and eliminated only in the final step.

steps.statement: Target K M x y h
steps.explanation: P: split W=⊥ or W≠⊥. In the latter case choose a nonzero coefficient, apply each T_ij and divide by that coefficient to place every basis vector in W. Thus W=⊤. Combine with nontriviality. The explicit induced brackets in N005 ensure invariance under these generators is precisely invariance for the Chevalley L_K action, including p=2. No algebraic-closure assumption or distinct reduced weights enter.

P.explanation: All p:ℕ with p.Prime correspond exactly to the source prime integers; lam remains an arbitrary integer constrained by H001, and K is an arbitrary field with CharP K p. V is an arbitrary complex vector space carrying the sl2 generator action: the three endomorphisms with H003 extend uniquely along the standard sl2 basis to the original Lie action, and restriction recovers them. H002 records the original dimension, irreducibility and highest-weight condition; H004 records exactly the chosen nonzero highest-weight vector. 53: 1. Read all supplied NL paragraphs before splitting. Retain the original route.
54:    Group algebraic normalization into one calculation when that avoids needless
55:    model/compiler round trips. Split an expensive representation/limit/transport
56:    bridge from subsequent straightforward applications when it has a useful
57:    closed interface. Finer splitting is a choice to test, not an objective.
58: 2. For each T, write a complete Lean proposition, exact direct input IDs and
59:    the NL paragraph IDs it implements. Input IDs are AND premises. Temporary
60:    assumptions are discharged within a proof or exported as a closed implication.
61: 3. Export every result that another T needs as a statement. Do not rely on
62:    a previous proof body's local notation, hidden facts or unavailable objects.
63:    Keep existence guards direct and quantify all locally introduced objects.
64: 4. List representation bridges, library application conditions and computational
65:    normalization in the explanation. A strategy suggests operations; it never
66:    supplies a theorem. Project premises stay explicit; all pinned Mathlib
67:    theorems may be used without separate registration.
68: 5. Run structure and type checks, then obtain the normal workflow's actual
69:    independent semantic interface review before proof dispatch. A plan whose
70:    transition cannot be justified is not rescued by well-formed syntax.
71: 
72: ## IR to Lean
73: 
74: 1. Give a worker the frozen contract, its one T packet, and its explicit direct
75:    input statements. Do not expose reference solutions or sibling proof bodies.
76:    Shared context contains definitions and parameters, not ambient hypotheses.
77: 2. Generate only the tactic body for the fixed T target. Use the pinned library
78:    to implement the NL step. Prefer explicit intermediate conclusions and
79:    library automation when it fits. No per-theorem Mathlib permission or
80:    correspondence ledger is required; actual Lean compilation checks its use.
81:    Follow [Lean implementation safeguards](lean-writing.md) for critical
82:    signatures, difficult implicit arguments, representation conversions and
83:    small checks after inference failures.
84: 3. Check locally. If it fails, preserve the goal, local context, diagnostic,
85:    attempted code and hashes. Continue a clear local repair directly. Optional
86:    obstacle lookup is available during local repair; no preliminary diagnosis
87:    is required for every ordinary error. Explicit located obstruction
88:    routing follows [proof repair](proof-repair.md). A Lean error category is an observation,
89:    not a root cause. The optional bank contains general implementation advice;
90:    it neither supplies missing facts nor promises a performance improvement.
91: 4. Test the retrieved recipe's preconditions. Prove a missing condition from
92:    allowed inputs, choose another applicable strategy, or abstain. Never append
93:    that condition to the target's assumptions. A judged mathematical gap returns
94:    to NL0/Audit A; elapsed time, search failure or network faults cannot establish
95:    one. Repeated no-progress retries warrant reconsidering the implementation
96:    route. Progress counters and repeated evidence do not authorize automatic
97:    retirement, pause or cancellation. The same assigned role handles actual
98:    feedback; retain every round and cost without inventing a case-time allowance.
99: 5. Freeze accepted proof bytes bound to contract and plan. Assemble the actual
100:    local proofs, compile P and print its signature/axioms. Recheck in a fresh
101:    verifier work directory. Local success without root closure is partial.
102: 6. Apply machine [Audit B](audit-b.md) after actual proof assembly. Bind the
103:    actual final E/P and meaning-determining environment to the reviewed frozen
104:    interface, with complete compilation, dependency and kernel-trust evidence.
105:    Normal acceptance inherits that earlier semantic review. Only a valid-proof
106:    interface deviation opens B-final; it cannot override a mechanical failure.
107: 
108: ## Use local Audit A notes when they can shorten an implementation route
109: 
110: Use familiar library interfaces directly. For an unfamiliar exact interface,
111: a relevant local note's checked declaration may save a lookup; otherwise use
112: ordinary pinned-library search. Neither case requires a preliminary note scan.
113: 
114: The main use is an application or transport obstacle. During the existing
115: worker's normal reasoning, relate the actual Lean goal and available context
116: to its mapped NL paragraph. If the local index suggests a useful note:
117: 
118: 1. Read that note's full grounds and justification. Identify the intended
119:    application, the precise premise it needs, and what the current context
120:    already supplies. A condition's mathematical source may have a different
121:    Lean representation from the required premise.
122:    Ground pointers address the audited NL packet, not positions in the current
123:    Lean context. Match their content to actual binders; never assume that an
124:    input index or an NL fact label is itself a Lean proof.
125: 2. Form the smallest useful intermediate goal connecting those available
126:    grounds to the premise. Prove it from permitted inputs and local facts,
127:    then try the intended application. Do not turn a note into a new assumption,
128:    require a separate helper theorem per note, or reconstruct a larger source
129:    argument merely because a routine interface premise is expressed differently.
130: 3. Check the actual Lean types, guards, equality/convergence mode and feedback.
131:    A verified mathematical note is not an executable proof or a guarantee of
132:    representation compatibility. If it does not fit, continue ordinary allowed
133:    search/repair; do not force its route or cycle through every note. A genuine
134:    source/interface change follows the existing review boundary.
135: 
136: For example, suppose a limit of `f` is established and the NL argument says
137: `g` agrees with `f` on a sufficiently small punctured neighborhood. To prove
138: the same limit for `g`, first express that local agreement as
139: `heq : f =ᶠ[l] g` for the actual filter `l`, then apply
140: `Filter.Tendsto.congr' heq hf`. The note can identify this intermediate premise
141: and its existing grounds; the worker still proves `heq`. This is a schematic
142: interface-bridge example, not a supplied proof of a benchmark obligation.
143: 
144: The canonical packet retains all selected audited notes and source bindings.
145: Under `local-background-on-demand-1`, a Yui proof worker initially sees only
146: its task's compact `background_note_index`: ID, location, fact, kind and any
147: checked declaration name. `read_background_note` returns one selected note's
148: complete material. No sibling notes/proofs or whole-case supplement are exposed
149: through that tool. Mathematical inputs and Audit B accounting remain unchanged.
150: There is no separate diagnosis model, mandatory lookup or claimed speedup.
151: 
152: ## Reuse and parallel work
153: 
154: Identify mathematical extraction candidates during translation-entry source
155: preparation, not after final worker packets exist. During interface/planning
156: work, identify repeated typed obligations and stable common Lean ports. Freeze
157: those interfaces without proving the entire project twice. Record object
158: identity and local views as specified in architecture.md; require explicit
159: proved bridges. Preserve natural node boundaries and apply shared-lemmas.md.
160: After freeze, lookup may fill an already declared interface with a compatible
161: checked proof; it does not discover new mathematical premises or mutate NL0.
162: 
163: When a reviewed shared export is compatible with a supplied store, attempt the
164: deterministic exact-key lookup and recheck its closed conditional proof in Lean.
165: On a miss use the ordinary worker. Do not add an LLM call solely to classify a
166: cache query. A strategy card is advice; a store entry is a checked conditional
167: proof with all its guards visible. Include source-cache elaboration costs.
168: 
169: Use the bounded scheduler after interfaces are frozen. Queue ownership, state
170: and cancellation follow [the execution protocol](execution-protocol.md).
171: Mathematical input dependencies become local binders for body work and actual proofs for final
172: assembly. A producer's failure leaves the final theorem incomplete. Record the
173: initial library, all admissions and each node's selected inputs. Never make a
174: shared theorem silently available through the global definition registry.
175: 
176: ## NL0 packet adapter
177: 
178: Run the existing parent tool, without changing its rules:
179: 
180: ```sh
181: python3 ../scripts/nl0.py packet /absolute/case/nl0.json \
182:   --spec /absolute/case/spec.json --inference R001
183: ```
184: 
185: Store the full output as the source artifact and its hash in the contract.
186: The translator still authors Lean representations and signatures; the adapter
187: exports audited information and is not a natural-language compiler.

namespace LatticeIR
def R (p : ℕ) : Subring ℚ :=
  Subring.closure {q : ℚ | ∃ a b : ℤ, ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ b ∧ q = (a : ℚ) / (b : ℚ)}
instance ratModule (V : Type*) [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] : Module ℚ V :=
  Module.compHom V (algebraMap ℚ ℂ)
instance complexAlgebra (p : ℕ) : Algebra (R p) ℂ :=
  ((algebraMap ℚ ℂ).comp (R p).subtype).toAlgebra
instance localModule (p : ℕ) (V : Type*) [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] : Module (R p) V :=
  Module.compHom V (algebraMap (R p) ℂ)
variable {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
def dp (f : Module.End ℂ V) (r : ℕ) : Module.End ℂ V :=
  ((r.factorial : ℂ)⁻¹) • f ^ r
def e (y : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (i : ℕ) : V := dp y i v
abbrev MR (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) := (R p) ⊗[ℤ] M
def mu (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) : MR p M →ₗ[R p] V :=
  M.subtype.liftBaseChange (R p)
abbrev VK (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V) := K ⊗[ℤ] M
def image (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) : Submodule (R p) V :=
  LinearMap.range (mu p M)
def Ji (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (y : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (i : ℕ) : Submodule (R p) ℂ :=
  letI : IsScalarTower (R p) ℂ V := IsScalarTower.of_compHom (R p) ℂ V
  letI : IsScalarTower (R p) ℂ ℂ := IsScalarTower.of_compHom (R p) ℂ ℂ
  (image p M).comap ((LinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℂ V (e y v i)).restrictScalars (R p))
def unit {F W : Type*} [Field F] [AddCommGroup W] [Module F W]
    {n : ℕ} (B : Module.Basis (Fin n) F W) (i j : Fin n) : Module.End F W :=
  (LinearMap.toSpanSingleton F W (B i)).comp (B.coord j)
def basisAt {F W : Type*} [Field F] [AddCommGroup W] [Module F W]
    {n : ℕ} (B : Module.Basis (Fin n) F W) (i : ℕ) : W :=
  if hi : i < n then B ⟨i, hi⟩ else 0
def Stable (M : Submodule ℤ V) (f : Module.End ℂ V) : Prop :=
  ∀ w ∈ M, f w ∈ M
def latticeOp (M : Submodule ℤ V) (f : Module.End ℂ V) : Module.End ℤ M :=
  letI := Classical.propDecidable
  if hf : Stable M f then (f.restrictScalars ℤ).restrict hf else 0
def kop (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V) (f : Module.End ℂ V) : Module.End K (VK K M) :=
  (latticeOp M f).baseChange K
def kdp {K W : Type*} [Field K] [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    (f : Module.End K W) (r : ℕ) : Module.End K W :=
  ((r.factorial : K)⁻¹) • f ^ r
def Coordinates (lam : ℤ) (y : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  ∃ B : Module.Basis (Fin (lam.toNat + 1)) ℂ V, ∀ i, B i = e y v i.val
def rop (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (f : Module.End ℂ V) : Module.End (R p) (MR p M) :=
  (latticeOp M f).baseChange (R p)
def pSub (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) : Submodule (R p) (MR p M) :=
  Submodule.span (R p) (Set.range (fun z : MR p M => (p : R p) • z))
abbrev QuotMR (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) := MR p M ⧸ pSub p M

def Strings (lam : ℤ) (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=

  (∀ d : ℕ, lam < (d : ℤ) → (y ^ d) v = 0) ∧

def RingCarrier (p : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ q : ℚ, q ∈ R p ↔ ∃ a b : ℤ, ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ b ∧ q = (a : ℚ) / (b : ℚ)

  LocalBasics p lam M x y ∧
  (∀ j : Fin (lam.toNat + 1), IsUnit (Nat.choose lam.toNat j.val : R p)) ∧

def CommonOutput (p : ℕ) (lam : ℤ) (M : Submodule ℤ V)

def PrincipalOutput (p : ℕ) (lam : ℤ) (M : Submodule ℤ V)

  ∃ b : ℂ, b ∈ Ji p M y v 0 ∧ b ≠ 0 ∧

    ∃ B : Module.Basis (Fin (lam.toNat + 1)) (R p) (MR p M),

def ReducedOutput (K : Type*) [Field K] (lam : ℤ) (M : Submodule ℤ V)

11: /-!
12: # The `ZMod n`-algebra structure on rings whose characteristic divides `n`
13: -/
14: 
15: @[expose] public section
16: 
17: assert_not_exists TwoSidedIdeal
18: 
19: namespace ZMod
20: 
21: variable (R : Type*) [Ring R]
22: 
23: instance (p : ℕ) : Subsingleton (Algebra (ZMod p) R) :=
24:   ⟨fun _ _ => Algebra.algebra_ext _ _ <| RingHom.congr_fun <| Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩
25: 
26: section
27: 
28: variable {n : ℕ} (m : ℕ) [CharP R m]
29: 
30: /-- The `ZMod n`-algebra structure on rings whose characteristic `m` divides `n`.
31: See note [reducible non-instances]. -/
32: abbrev algebra' (h : m ∣ n) : Algebra (ZMod n) R where
33:   algebraMap := ZMod.castHom h R
34:   smul := fun a r => cast a * r
35:   commutes' := fun a r =>
36:     show (cast a * r : R) = r * cast a by
37:       rcases ZMod.intCast_surjective a with ⟨k, rfl⟩
38:       change ZMod.castHom h R k * r = r * ZMod.castHom h R k
39:       rw [map_intCast, Int.cast_comm]
40:   smul_def' := fun _ _ => rfl
41: 
42: end
43: 
44: /-- The `ZMod p`-algebra structure on a ring of characteristic `p`. This is not an
45: instance since it creates a diamond with `Algebra.id`.
46: See note [reducible non-instances]. -/
47: abbrev algebra (p : ℕ) [CharP R p] : Algebra (ZMod p) R :=
48:   algebra' R p dvd_rfl
49: 
50: set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
51: /-- Any ring with a `ZMod p`-module structure can be upgraded to a `ZMod p`-algebra. Not an
52: instance because this is usually not the default way, and this will cause typeclass search loop. -/
53: @[implicit_reducible]
54: def algebraOfModule (n : ℕ) (R : Type*) [Ring R] [Module (ZMod n) R] : Algebra (ZMod n) R :=
55:   Algebra.ofModule' (proof · · |>.1) (proof · · |>.2) where
56:   proof (r : ZMod n) (x : R) : r • 1 * x = r • x ∧ x * r • 1 = r • x := by
57:     obtain _ | n := n
58:     · obtain rfl : ((inferInstance : Module ℤ R)) = ‹_› := Subsingleton.elim _ _
59:       simp [ZMod, Int.cast_comm]
60:     · obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := ZMod.natCast_zmod_surjective r
61:       simp [Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul, Nat.cast_comm]
62: 
63: instance instIsScalarTower (n : ℕ) (R M : Type*) [Ring R] [AddCommGroup M]
64:     [Module (ZMod n) R] [m₁ : Module (ZMod n) M] [Module R M] :
65:     IsScalarTower (ZMod n) R M := by
66:   let := ZMod.algebraOfModule n R
67:   let m₂ := Module.compHom M (algebraMap (ZMod n) R)
68:   obtain rfl : m₁ = m₂ := Subsingleton.elim _ _
69:   exact ⟨fun x y z ↦ by rw [Algebra.smul_def, mul_smul]; rfl⟩
70: 
71: end ZMod

import Mathlib
open scoped TensorProduct
noncomputable section
universe uK uV
namespace LatticeIR
def R (p : ℕ) : Subring ℚ :=
  Subring.closure {q : ℚ | ∃ a b : ℤ, ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ b ∧ q = (a : ℚ) / (b : ℚ)}
instance ratModule (V : Type*) [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] : Module ℚ V :=
  Module.compHom V (algebraMap ℚ ℂ)
instance complexAlgebra (p : ℕ) : Algebra (R p) ℂ :=
  ((algebraMap ℚ ℂ).comp (R p).subtype).toAlgebra
instance localModule (p : ℕ) (V : Type*) [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] : Module (R p) V :=
  Module.compHom V (algebraMap (R p) ℂ)
variable {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
def dp (f : Module.End ℂ V) (r : ℕ) : Module.End ℂ V :=
  ((r.factorial : ℂ)⁻¹) • f ^ r
def e (y : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (i : ℕ) : V := dp y i v
abbrev MR (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) := (R p) ⊗[ℤ] M
def mu (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) : MR p M →ₗ[R p] V :=
  M.subtype.liftBaseChange (R p)
abbrev VK (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V) := K ⊗[ℤ] M
def image (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) : Submodule (R p) V :=
  LinearMap.range (mu p M)
def Ji (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (y : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (i : ℕ) : Submodule (R p) ℂ :=
  letI : IsScalarTower (R p) ℂ V := IsScalarTower.of_compHom (R p) ℂ V
  letI : IsScalarTower (R p) ℂ ℂ := IsScalarTower.of_compHom (R p) ℂ ℂ
  (image p M).comap ((LinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℂ V (e y v i)).restrictScalars (R p))
def unit {F W : Type*} [Field F] [AddCommGroup W] [Module F W]
    {n : ℕ} (B : Module.Basis (Fin n) F W) (i j : Fin n) : Module.End F W :=
  (LinearMap.toSpanSingleton F W (B i)).comp (B.coord j)
def basisAt {F W : Type*} [Field F] [AddCommGroup W] [Module F W]
    {n : ℕ} (B : Module.Basis (Fin n) F W) (i : ℕ) : W :=
  if hi : i < n then B ⟨i, hi⟩ else 0
def Stable (M : Submodule ℤ V) (f : Module.End ℂ V) : Prop :=
  ∀ w ∈ M, f w ∈ M
def latticeOp (M : Submodule ℤ V) (f : Module.End ℂ V) : Module.End ℤ M :=
  letI := Classical.propDecidable
  if hf : Stable M f then (f.restrictScalars ℤ).restrict hf else 0
def kop (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V) (f : Module.End ℂ V) : Module.End K (VK K M) :=
  (latticeOp M f).baseChange K
def kdp {K W : Type*} [Field K] [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    (f : Module.End K W) (r : ℕ) : Module.End K W :=
  ((r.factorial : K)⁻¹) • f ^ r
def Coordinates (lam : ℤ) (y : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  ∃ B : Module.Basis (Fin (lam.toNat + 1)) ℂ V, ∀ i, B i = e y v i.val
def rop (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (f : Module.End ℂ V) : Module.End (R p) (MR p M) :=
  (latticeOp M f).baseChange (R p)
def pSub (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) : Submodule (R p) (MR p M) :=
  Submodule.span (R p) (Set.range (fun z : MR p M => (p : R p) • z))
abbrev QuotMR (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) := MR p M ⧸ pSub p M
def Inv {F W : Type*} [Field F] [AddCommGroup W] [Module F W]
    (W' : Submodule F W) (f : Module.End F W) : Prop :=
  ∀ w ∈ W', f w ∈ W'
def Actions {F W : Type*} [Field F] [AddCommGroup W] [Module F W]
    (lam : ℤ) (a b c : Module.End F W) (B : Module.Basis (Fin (lam.toNat + 1)) F W) : Prop :=
  (∀ i, a (B i) = if i.val = 0 then 0 else
    ((lam - (i.val : ℤ) + 1 : ℤ) : F) • basisAt B (i.val - 1)) ∧
  (∀ i, b (B i) = if i.val < lam.toNat then
    ((i.val + 1 : ℕ) : F) • basisAt B (i.val + 1) else 0) ∧
  (∀ i, c (B i) = ((lam - 2 * (i.val : ℤ) : ℤ) : F) • B i)
def Strings (lam : ℤ) (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  (∀ d : ℕ, h ((y ^ d) v) = ((lam - 2 * (d : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℂ) • (y ^ d) v) ∧
  (∀ d : ℕ, 1 ≤ d → x ((y ^ d) v) =
    (((d : ℤ) * (lam - (d : ℤ) + 1) : ℤ) : ℂ) • (y ^ (d - 1)) v)
def ComplexOutput (lam : ℤ) (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  0 < lam + 1 ∧ Fintype.card (Fin (lam.toNat + 1)) = lam.toNat + 1 ∧
  Coordinates lam y v ∧ Strings lam x y h v ∧
  (∀ d : ℕ, lam < (d : ℤ) → (y ^ d) v = 0) ∧
  (∀ B : Module.Basis (Fin (lam.toNat + 1)) ℂ V,
    (∀ i, B i = e y v i.val) → Actions lam x y h B) ∧
  (∀ (r : ℕ) (i : Fin (lam.toNat + 1)),
    dp x r (e y v i.val) =
      if r ≤ i.val then ((Nat.choose (lam.toNat - i.val + r) r : ℕ) : ℂ) • e y v (i.val - r) else 0) ∧
  (∀ (r : ℕ) (i : Fin (lam.toNat + 1)),
    dp y r (e y v i.val) =
      if i.val + r ≤ lam.toNat then ((Nat.choose (i.val + r) r : ℕ) : ℂ) • e y v (i.val + r) else 0)
def RingCarrier (p : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ q : ℚ, q ∈ R p ↔ ∃ a b : ℤ, ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ b ∧ q = (a : ℚ) / (b : ℚ)
def LocalBasics (p : ℕ) (lam : ℤ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (x y : Module.End ℂ V) : Prop :=
  RingCarrier p ∧ Function.Injective (mu p M) ∧
  Nonempty (Module.Basis (Fin (lam.toNat + 1)) (R p) (MR p M)) ∧
  Submodule.span ℂ (image p M : Set V) = ⊤ ∧
  (∀ r : ℕ, (∀ z, mu p M (rop p M (dp x r) z) = dp x r (mu p M z)) ∧
    (∀ z, mu p M (rop p M (dp y r) z) = dp y r (mu p M z))) ∧
  (∀ (r : ℕ) (w : V), w ∈ image p M → dp x r w ∈ image p M ∧ dp y r w ∈ image p M)
def MatrixOutput (p : ℕ) (lam : ℤ) (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (x y : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  LocalBasics p lam M x y ∧
  (∀ j : Fin (lam.toNat + 1), IsUnit (Nat.choose lam.toNat j.val : R p)) ∧
  (∀ B : Module.Basis (Fin (lam.toNat + 1)) ℂ V,
    (∀ i, B i = e y v i.val) → ∀ i j,
    unit B i j =
      ((Nat.choose lam.toNat j.val : ℂ)⁻¹) •
      (dp x (lam.toNat - i.val) * dp y lam.toNat * dp x lam.toNat * dp y (lam.toNat - j.val)) ∧
    ∀ w ∈ image p M, unit B i j w ∈ image p M)
def CommonOutput (p : ℕ) (lam : ℤ) (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (x y : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  0 < lam + 1 ∧ Coordinates lam y v ∧ LocalBasics p lam M x y ∧
  (∀ i : Fin (lam.toNat + 1), Ji p M y v i.val = Ji p M y v 0) ∧
  (Ji p M y v 0).FG ∧ Ji p M y v 0 ≠ ⊥ ∧
  (∃ F : ((Fin (lam.toNat + 1)) → Ji p M y v 0) ≃ₗ[R p] MR p M,
    ∀ c, mu p M (F c) = ∑ i, ((c i : Ji p M y v 0) : ℂ) • e y v i.val)
def PrincipalOutput (p : ℕ) (lam : ℤ) (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (y : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  ∃ b : ℂ, b ∈ Ji p M y v 0 ∧ b ≠ 0 ∧
    Ji p M y v 0 = Submodule.span (R p) {b} ∧
    ∃ B : Module.Basis (Fin (lam.toNat + 1)) (R p) (MR p M),
      ∀ i, mu p M (B i) = b • e y v i.val
def ReducedOutput (K : Type*) [Field K] (lam : ℤ) (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) : Prop :=
  0 < lam + 1 ∧ Stable M x ∧ Stable M y ∧ Stable M h ∧
  kop K M h = kop K M x * kop K M y - kop K M y * kop K M x ∧
  kop K M h * kop K M x - kop K M x * kop K M h = (2 : K) • kop K M x ∧
  kop K M h * kop K M y - kop K M y * kop K M h = (-2 : K) • kop K M y ∧
  ∃ B : Module.Basis (Fin (lam.toNat + 1)) K (VK K M),
    Actions lam (kop K M x) (kop K M y) (kop K M h) B ∧
    (∀ r : ℕ, r ≤ lam.toNat → (r.factorial : K) ≠ 0 ∧
      (latticeOp M (dp x r)).baseChange K = kdp (kop K M x) r ∧
      (latticeOp M (dp y r)).baseChange K = kdp (kop K M y) r) ∧
    (∀ i j : Fin (lam.toNat + 1), (Nat.choose lam.toNat j.val : K) ≠ 0 ∧
      unit B i j = ((Nat.choose lam.toNat j.val : K)⁻¹) •
        (kdp (kop K M x) (lam.toNat - i.val) * kdp (kop K M y) lam.toNat *
         kdp (kop K M x) lam.toNat * kdp (kop K M y) (lam.toNat - j.val)))
def Target (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V) (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) : Prop :=
  Nontrivial (VK K M) ∧ ∀ W : Submodule K (VK K M),
    Inv W (kop K M x) → Inv W (kop K M y) → Inv W (kop K M h) → W = ⊥ ∨ W = ⊤
def FractionData (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (y : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  let J := Ji p M y v 0;
    (∃ theta : (ℚ ⊗[R p] J) →ₗ[ℚ] ℂ,
      (∀ (q : ℚ) (c : J), theta (TensorProduct.tmul (R p) q c) = (q : ℂ) * (c : ℂ)) ∧
      Function.Injective theta) ∧ FiniteDimensional ℚ (ℚ ⊗[R p] J)
def RationalLine (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (y : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  let J := Ji p M y v 0;
    Module.finrank ℚ (ℚ ⊗[R p] J) = 1 ∧
    ∀ a : ℂ, a ∈ J → a ≠ 0 → ∀ c : ℂ, c ∈ J → ∃! q : ℚ, c = (q : ℂ) * a
def ScalarExtensionData (p : ℕ) (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V) : Prop :=
  ∀ hc : CharP K p,
    letI : CharP K p := hc
    letI : Algebra (ZMod p) K := ZMod.algebra K p
    ∃ rho : R p →+* K,
      RingHom.ker rho = Ideal.span {(p : R p)} ∧
      (∀ (r : R p) (a b : ℤ), ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ b →
        (r : ℚ) = (a : ℚ) / (b : ℚ) → rho r = (a : K) / (b : K)) ∧
      letI : Algebra (R p) K := rho.toAlgebra
      ∃ phi : VK K M ≃ₗ[K] (K ⊗[R p] MR p M),
        (∀ (c : K) (m : M), phi (TensorProduct.tmul ℤ c m) =
          TensorProduct.tmul (R p) c (TensorProduct.tmul ℤ (1 : R p) m)) ∧
        (∀ f : Module.End ℂ V, Stable M f → ∀ z,
          phi (kop K M f z) = ((latticeOp M f).baseChange (R p)).baseChange K (phi z)) ∧
        ∃ qmod : Module (ZMod p) (QuotMR p M),
          letI : Module (ZMod p) (QuotMR p M) := qmod
          ∃ eta : (K ⊗[R p] MR p M) ≃ₗ[K] (K ⊗[ZMod p] QuotMR p M),
            ∀ (c : K) (z : MR p M), eta (TensorProduct.tmul (R p) c z) =
              TensorProduct.tmul (ZMod p) c (Submodule.Quotient.mk z)
def ReducedBasisData (p : ℕ) (K : Type*) [Field K] (lam : ℤ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  ∃ rho : R p →+* K,
    letI : Algebra (R p) K := rho.toAlgebra
    ∃ phi : VK K M ≃ₗ[K] (K ⊗[R p] MR p M),
      (∀ (c : K) (m : M), phi (TensorProduct.tmul ℤ c m) =
        TensorProduct.tmul (R p) c (TensorProduct.tmul ℤ (1 : R p) m)) ∧
      (∀ f : Module.End ℂ V, Stable M f → ∀ z,
        phi (kop K M f z) = ((latticeOp M f).baseChange (R p)).baseChange K (phi z)) ∧
      ∃ b : ℂ, b ≠ 0 ∧
        ∃ BR : Module.Basis (Fin (lam.toNat + 1)) (R p) (MR p M),
          (∀ i, mu p M (BR i) = b • e y v i.val) ∧
          ∃ B : Module.Basis (Fin (lam.toNat + 1)) K (VK K M),
            (∀ i, phi (B i) = TensorProduct.tmul (R p) (1 : K) (BR i)) ∧
            Actions lam (kop K M x) (kop K M y) (kop K M h) B

import Mathlib
open scoped TensorProduct
noncomputable section
universe uK uV
namespace LatticeIR
def R (p : ℕ) : Subring ℚ :=
  Subring.closure {q : ℚ | ∃ a b : ℤ, ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ b ∧ q = (a : ℚ) / (b : ℚ)}
instance ratModule (V : Type*) [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] : Module ℚ V :=
  Module.compHom V (algebraMap ℚ ℂ)
instance complexAlgebra (p : ℕ) : Algebra (R p) ℂ :=
  ((algebraMap ℚ ℂ).comp (R p).subtype).toAlgebra
instance localModule (p : ℕ) (V : Type*) [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] : Module (R p) V :=
  Module.compHom V (algebraMap (R p) ℂ)
variable {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
def dp (f : Module.End ℂ V) (r : ℕ) : Module.End ℂ V :=
  ((r.factorial : ℂ)⁻¹) • f ^ r
def e (y : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (i : ℕ) : V := dp y i v
abbrev MR (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) := (R p) ⊗[ℤ] M
def mu (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) : MR p M →ₗ[R p] V :=
  M.subtype.liftBaseChange (R p)
abbrev VK (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V) := K ⊗[ℤ] M
def image (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) : Submodule (R p) V :=
  LinearMap.range (mu p M)
def Ji (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (y : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (i : ℕ) : Submodule (R p) ℂ :=
  letI : IsScalarTower (R p) ℂ V := IsScalarTower.of_compHom (R p) ℂ V
  letI : IsScalarTower (R p) ℂ ℂ := IsScalarTower.of_compHom (R p) ℂ ℂ
  (image p M).comap ((LinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℂ V (e y v i)).restrictScalars (R p))
def unit {F W : Type*} [Field F] [AddCommGroup W] [Module F W]
    {n : ℕ} (B : Module.Basis (Fin n) F W) (i j : Fin n) : Module.End F W :=
  (LinearMap.toSpanSingleton F W (B i)).comp (B.coord j)
def basisAt {F W : Type*} [Field F] [AddCommGroup W] [Module F W]
    {n : ℕ} (B : Module.Basis (Fin n) F W) (i : ℕ) : W :=
  if hi : i < n then B ⟨i, hi⟩ else 0
def Stable (M : Submodule ℤ V) (f : Module.End ℂ V) : Prop :=
  ∀ w ∈ M, f w ∈ M
def latticeOp (M : Submodule ℤ V) (f : Module.End ℂ V) : Module.End ℤ M :=
  letI := Classical.propDecidable
  if hf : Stable M f then (f.restrictScalars ℤ).restrict hf else 0
def kop (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V) (f : Module.End ℂ V) : Module.End K (VK K M) :=
  (latticeOp M f).baseChange K
def kdp {K W : Type*} [Field K] [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    (f : Module.End K W) (r : ℕ) : Module.End K W :=
  ((r.factorial : K)⁻¹) • f ^ r
def Coordinates (lam : ℤ) (y : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  ∃ B : Module.Basis (Fin (lam.toNat + 1)) ℂ V, ∀ i, B i = e y v i.val
def rop (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (f : Module.End ℂ V) : Module.End (R p) (MR p M) :=
  (latticeOp M f).baseChange (R p)
def pSub (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) : Submodule (R p) (MR p M) :=
  Submodule.span (R p) (Set.range (fun z : MR p M => (p : R p) • z))
abbrev QuotMR (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) := MR p M ⧸ pSub p M
def Inv {F W : Type*} [Field F] [AddCommGroup W] [Module F W]
    (W' : Submodule F W) (f : Module.End F W) : Prop :=
  ∀ w ∈ W', f w ∈ W'
def Actions {F W : Type*} [Field F] [AddCommGroup W] [Module F W]
    (lam : ℤ) (a b c : Module.End F W) (B : Module.Basis (Fin (lam.toNat + 1)) F W) : Prop :=
  (∀ i, a (B i) = if i.val = 0 then 0 else
    ((lam - (i.val : ℤ) + 1 : ℤ) : F) • basisAt B (i.val - 1)) ∧
  (∀ i, b (B i) = if i.val < lam.toNat then
    ((i.val + 1 : ℕ) : F) • basisAt B (i.val + 1) else 0) ∧
  (∀ i, c (B i) = ((lam - 2 * (i.val : ℤ) : ℤ) : F) • B i)
def Strings (lam : ℤ) (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  (∀ d : ℕ, h ((y ^ d) v) = ((lam - 2 * (d : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℂ) • (y ^ d) v) ∧
  (∀ d : ℕ, 1 ≤ d → x ((y ^ d) v) =
    (((d : ℤ) * (lam - (d : ℤ) + 1) : ℤ) : ℂ) • (y ^ (d - 1)) v)
def ComplexOutput (lam : ℤ) (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  0 < lam + 1 ∧ Fintype.card (Fin (lam.toNat + 1)) = lam.toNat + 1 ∧
  Coordinates lam y v ∧ Strings lam x y h v ∧
  (∀ d : ℕ, lam < (d : ℤ) → (y ^ d) v = 0) ∧
  (∀ B : Module.Basis (Fin (lam.toNat + 1)) ℂ V,
    (∀ i, B i = e y v i.val) → Actions lam x y h B) ∧
  (∀ (r : ℕ) (i : Fin (lam.toNat + 1)),
    dp x r (e y v i.val) =
      if r ≤ i.val then ((Nat.choose (lam.toNat - i.val + r) r : ℕ) : ℂ) • e y v (i.val - r) else 0) ∧
  (∀ (r : ℕ) (i : Fin (lam.toNat + 1)),
    dp y r (e y v i.val) =
      if i.val + r ≤ lam.toNat then ((Nat.choose (i.val + r) r : ℕ) : ℂ) • e y v (i.val + r) else 0)
def RingCarrier (p : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ q : ℚ, q ∈ R p ↔ ∃ a b : ℤ, ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ b ∧ q = (a : ℚ) / (b : ℚ)
def LocalBasics (p : ℕ) (lam : ℤ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (x y : Module.End ℂ V) : Prop :=
  RingCarrier p ∧ Function.Injective (mu p M) ∧
  Nonempty (Module.Basis (Fin (lam.toNat + 1)) (R p) (MR p M)) ∧
  Submodule.span ℂ (image p M : Set V) = ⊤ ∧
  (∀ r : ℕ, (∀ z, mu p M (rop p M (dp x r) z) = dp x r (mu p M z)) ∧
    (∀ z, mu p M (rop p M (dp y r) z) = dp y r (mu p M z))) ∧
  (∀ (r : ℕ) (w : V), w ∈ image p M → dp x r w ∈ image p M ∧ dp y r w ∈ image p M)
def MatrixOutput (p : ℕ) (lam : ℤ) (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (x y : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  LocalBasics p lam M x y ∧
  (∀ j : Fin (lam.toNat + 1), IsUnit (Nat.choose lam.toNat j.val : R p)) ∧
  (∀ B : Module.Basis (Fin (lam.toNat + 1)) ℂ V,
    (∀ i, B i = e y v i.val) → ∀ i j,
    unit B i j =
      ((Nat.choose lam.toNat j.val : ℂ)⁻¹) •
      (dp x (lam.toNat - i.val) * dp y lam.toNat * dp x lam.toNat * dp y (lam.toNat - j.val)) ∧
    ∀ w ∈ image p M, unit B i j w ∈ image p M)
def CommonOutput (p : ℕ) (lam : ℤ) (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (x y : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  0 < lam + 1 ∧ Coordinates lam y v ∧ LocalBasics p lam M x y ∧
  (∀ i : Fin (lam.toNat + 1), Ji p M y v i.val = Ji p M y v 0) ∧
  (Ji p M y v 0).FG ∧ Ji p M y v 0 ≠ ⊥ ∧
  (∃ F : ((Fin (lam.toNat + 1)) → Ji p M y v 0) ≃ₗ[R p] MR p M,
    ∀ c, mu p M (F c) = ∑ i, ((c i : Ji p M y v 0) : ℂ) • e y v i.val)
def PrincipalOutput (p : ℕ) (lam : ℤ) (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (y : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  ∃ b : ℂ, b ∈ Ji p M y v 0 ∧ b ≠ 0 ∧
    Ji p M y v 0 = Submodule.span (R p) {b} ∧
    ∃ B : Module.Basis (Fin (lam.toNat + 1)) (R p) (MR p M),
      ∀ i, mu p M (B i) = b • e y v i.val
def ReducedOutput (K : Type*) [Field K] (lam : ℤ) (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) : Prop :=
  0 < lam + 1 ∧ Stable M x ∧ Stable M y ∧ Stable M h ∧
  kop K M h = kop K M x * kop K M y - kop K M y * kop K M x ∧
  kop K M h * kop K M x - kop K M x * kop K M h = (2 : K) • kop K M x ∧
  kop K M h * kop K M y - kop K M y * kop K M h = (-2 : K) • kop K M y ∧
  ∃ B : Module.Basis (Fin (lam.toNat + 1)) K (VK K M),
    Actions lam (kop K M x) (kop K M y) (kop K M h) B ∧
    (∀ r : ℕ, r ≤ lam.toNat → (r.factorial : K) ≠ 0 ∧
      (latticeOp M (dp x r)).baseChange K = kdp (kop K M x) r ∧
      (latticeOp M (dp y r)).baseChange K = kdp (kop K M y) r) ∧
    (∀ i j : Fin (lam.toNat + 1), (Nat.choose lam.toNat j.val : K) ≠ 0 ∧
      unit B i j = ((Nat.choose lam.toNat j.val : K)⁻¹) •
        (kdp (kop K M x) (lam.toNat - i.val) * kdp (kop K M y) lam.toNat *
         kdp (kop K M x) lam.toNat * kdp (kop K M y) (lam.toNat - j.val)))
def Target (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V) (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) : Prop :=
  Nontrivial (VK K M) ∧ ∀ W : Submodule K (VK K M),
    Inv W (kop K M x) → Inv W (kop K M y) → Inv W (kop K M h) → W = ⊥ ∨ W = ⊤
def FractionData (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (y : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  let J := Ji p M y v 0;
    (∃ theta : (ℚ ⊗[R p] J) →ₗ[ℚ] ℂ,
      (∀ (q : ℚ) (c : J), theta (TensorProduct.tmul (R p) q c) = (q : ℂ) * (c : ℂ)) ∧
      Function.Injective theta) ∧ FiniteDimensional ℚ (ℚ ⊗[R p] J)
def RationalLine (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (y : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  let J := Ji p M y v 0;
    Module.finrank ℚ (ℚ ⊗[R p] J) = 1 ∧
    ∀ a : ℂ, a ∈ J → a ≠ 0 → ∀ c : ℂ, c ∈ J → ∃! q : ℚ, c = (q : ℂ) * a
def ScalarExtensionData (p : ℕ) (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V) : Prop :=
  ∀ hc : CharP K p,
    letI : CharP K p := hc
    letI : Algebra (ZMod p) K := ZMod.algebra K p
    ∃ rho : R p →+* K,
      RingHom.ker rho = Ideal.span {(p : R p)} ∧
      (∀ (r : R p) (a b : ℤ), ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ b →
        (r : ℚ) = (a : ℚ) / (b : ℚ) → rho r = (a : K) / (b : K)) ∧
      letI : Algebra (R p) K := rho.toAlgebra
      ∃ phi : VK K M ≃ₗ[K] (K ⊗[R p] MR p M),
        (∀ (c : K) (m : M), phi (TensorProduct.tmul ℤ c m) =
          TensorProduct.tmul (R p) c (TensorProduct.tmul ℤ (1 : R p) m)) ∧
        (∀ f : Module.End ℂ V, Stable M f → ∀ z,
          phi (kop K M f z) = ((latticeOp M f).baseChange (R p)).baseChange K (phi z)) ∧
        ∃ qmod : Module (ZMod p) (QuotMR p M),
          letI : Module (ZMod p) (QuotMR p M) := qmod
          ∃ eta : (K ⊗[R p] MR p M) ≃ₗ[K] (K ⊗[ZMod p] QuotMR p M),
            ∀ (c : K) (z : MR p M), eta (TensorProduct.tmul (R p) c z) =
              TensorProduct.tmul (ZMod p) c (Submodule.Quotient.mk z)
def ReducedBasisData (p : ℕ) (K : Type*) [Field K] (lam : ℤ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  ∃ rho : R p →+* K,
    letI : Algebra (R p) K := rho.toAlgebra
    ∃ phi : VK K M ≃ₗ[K] (K ⊗[R p] MR p M),
      (∀ (c : K) (m : M), phi (TensorProduct.tmul ℤ c m) =
        TensorProduct.tmul (R p) c (TensorProduct.tmul ℤ (1 : R p) m)) ∧
      (∀ f : Module.End ℂ V, Stable M f → ∀ z,
        phi (kop K M f z) = ((latticeOp M f).baseChange (R p)).baseChange K (phi z)) ∧
      ∃ b : ℂ, b ≠ 0 ∧
        ∃ BR : Module.Basis (Fin (lam.toNat + 1)) (R p) (MR p M),
          (∀ i, mu p M (BR i) = b • e y v i.val) ∧
          ∃ B : Module.Basis (Fin (lam.toNat + 1)) K (VK K M),
            (∀ i, phi (B i) = TensorProduct.tmul (R p) (1 : K) (BR i)) ∧
            Actions lam (kop K M x) (kop K M y) (kop K M h) B
end LatticeIR
